realization: finite named Entity fields hold immutable snapshots from their exact generated Entity provider, never raw records or identity references
provider: typescript.owned-entity-component/v1-candidate; isOwned, key and equals over private validated snapshot membership and identity keys
equality: Entity type and declared identity only; nonidentity state is retained and validated but does not enter embedded Entity equality
composition: Entity or Value Object fields, optional/list/set and named/inline sum payloads; sets reject distinct snapshots with equal identities
validation: children must already have passed their own factory validation; parent validates ownership and its declared Rules; child extensions are neither inferred nor inherited
references: v7 descriptors and type-only targets preserved; an embedded snapshot includes child fields, unlike a scalar or composite identity reference
cycles: existing checked embedding cycles reject; scalar identity-reference cycles remain permitted
rules: existing explicit String/Bool bindings through owned Value Objects only; Entity field traversal for Rules remains a separate slice
compatibility: versions 1-7 retain contracts and output; original private value helpers, checked models, profiles and default compiler unchanged
